flash_697636.description: Binyamin Regional Council: Three injured in ramming attack near Jericho

flash_697635.description: Ramming attack near Jericho: The two injured Israelis are in light condition

flash_697634.description:
United Airlines announced that it is experiencing a "widespread systems outage" and is working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

"We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We're aware of the widespread system outage, and our teams are working hard to get things back up and running as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience while we work through this," the airline said.

flash_697633.description:
The IDF announced that it received a report of an attempted terrorist attack in the Jericho area.

IDF forces were dispatched to the scene and set up roadblocks in the area. The circumstances of the incident are under investigation.

flash_697631.description: MK Elyasaf Peretz arrives at MK Elisha Medan's unity tent with a bag of food and joked: "I'm Moroccan, you can't come empty-handed".

flash_697657.description: Billionaire investor Warren Buffett is donating approximately $5.5 billion in Berkshire Hathaway shares to four charitable foundations associated with his family, accelerating his long-standing commitment to give away his entire fortune.

flash_697656.description:
Saudi-backed forces in Yemen have withdrawn from the area near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait in the Red Sea amid an advance by the Houthis toward the port city of Aden, Kan News reported.

A source in one of the factions said the forces believe Saudi Arabia is not sufficiently determined in its fight against the Houthis and that its air support is inadequate.

According to the source, the forces have decided to focus on defending Aden amid concerns that fighters on the ground are becoming "cannon fodder."

flash_697654.description: Aryeh Eldad accuses Lieberman of contradicting his criticism of the previous draft bill with his new proposal and consultation with Rabbi Landau.

flash_697652.description: A Hamas-affiliated channel released new footage of the Hamas leader, believed to have been filmed at a school in Rafah.

flash_697650.description: United Torah Judaism chairman Yaakov Asher confirms he is speaking with figures on both sides of the political spectrum: The directive we received is to examine all options.

flash_697648.description: Vice President JD Vance rejects claims of a rift with Trump over the Iran war, defends the administration's military achievements and addresses criticism of failed talks.

flash_697646.description: Russian hackers stole hundreds of thousands of files from an Israeli company and used artificial intelligence to determine the ransom demand and negotiate payment.

flash_697644.description: NYC Council Speaker Julie Menin denounces public displays of support for Hamas and Hezbollah, warning of rising antisemitism and inadequate Holocaust education.

flash_697642.description: Sen. Elissa Slotkin faces backlash from some Michigan Jews over her support for Abdul El-Sayed and her shifting stance on Israel, dividing former supporters.

flash_697640.description:
The IDF said terrorists rammed an Israeli vehicle near Jericho before exiting their car with weapons and attacking its occupants. Rocks were subsequently hurled at the Israelis, who opened fire to remove the threat. Israeli and Palestinian Arab casualties were reported.

Security forces were dispatched to the scene and are pursuing suspects while establishing roadblocks throughout the area. The incident remains under investigation.

flash_697639.description:
MK Limor Sonn Har Melech appealed to incoming Knesset Speaker Matan Kahana over the lack of female representation, claiming that the opposition bloc had not nominated a single woman for the position of Deputy Knesset Speaker.

She called for a review of the proposed lineup of deputy speakers to ensure adequate representation for women.

flash_697637.description:
United Airlines told Fox News Digital it had resolved a technical issue that delayed departing flights.

"We have resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures. While some flights were delayed, there was no impact on flights in progress, or on United Express flights," United Airlines' Media Relations told Fox News Digital.

"There is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related issue," the airline added.

flash_697632.description:
According to an initial report, Palestinian Arabs rammed their vehicle into a car carrying Israelis who were traveling to the new community of Ir HaTmarim near Jericho. The Palestinians then allegedly approached them armed with clubs and possibly axes.

Two injured Israelis reached the Jewish compound and are awaiting medical teams.

flash_697727.description: Nvidia CEO in first statement: If asked, I would be happy to return to the role

flash_697726.description: Britain's Charity Commission launches compliance case into a London Jewish community center after receiving complaints that it advertised medical jobs in Judea and Samaria.

flash_697724.description:
Judea and Samaria Border Police officers arrested, at the direction of the Shin Bet, two wanted Hamas terrorists suspected of involvement in terrorist activity within the organization's military wing.

During the operation, the undercover agents secretly arrived at the buildings where the wanted individuals were staying, surrounded them, broke in and carried out the arrests.

flash_697722.description:
According to a CNN report from sources in the field, the classified communications network NSA Net, used by the US National Security Agency (NSA), has been shut down.

The network allows agency employees to exchange classified information. According to the sources, there is no evidence at this stage that the malfunction was caused by a cyber attack.

flash_697720.description: A joint investigation uncovered a network allegedly directed by an Iranian citizen linked to intelligence officials. Its members also held clandestine meetings in Iran. A manhunt is underway for another suspect.

flash_697718.description: US Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz performed push-ups alongside US Marines guarding the American Embassy in Beirut, honoring the 241 Americans killed in the 1983 terrorist attack.

flash_697716.description: US Ambassador Mike Waltz calls for a new security arrangement in Lebanon, emphasizing the need for a single national army and welcoming Lebanese President Joseph Aoun's willingness to pursue peace talks with Israel.

flash_697714.description: Former Israeli Navy commander Vice Adm. (res.) Eliezer Marom assesses the window for a US strike on Iran, adding that Israel will be part of the campaign.

flash_697712.description: How to explain a singularity that rears its head time and again in the United States. Opinion.

flash_697710.description: Israeli-American Council raises alarm over NYC mayor's decision to dismantle specialized NYPD unit, warning of threats to Jewish community as more than half of the city's hate crimes target Jews.

flash_697708.description: The Knesset votes this afternoon on a new speaker. Eisenkot's bloc backs Matan Kahana; Likud backs Ofir Katz, with Shas and UTJ support. Arab-party deputy speaker posts are disputed, and the opposition fears attempts to delay the vote.

flash_697706.description: Regavim petitions court to demolish illegal compounds along major Jerusalem highway

flash_697704.description: Israel's busiest emergency department expands by 50%, adding more than 40 treatment stations as the Be'er Sheva hospital rebuilds following the October 7 massacre and a direct Iranian missile strike.

flash_697702.description: Avishai Breier, 51, a reserve officer from Modi'in-Maccabim-Re'ut, died after summiting Kilimanjaro. Friends tried to save him, carrying his stretcher for hours. He served hundreds of reserve days since Oct. 7, leaving a wife and three children.

flash_697700.description: With his city located 600 meters from the fence, Rosh Ha'Ayin Mayor Raz Sagi is working to prevent an October 7-style terrorist attack on the city.

flash_697698.description: Bus inspectors filmed beating a haredi boy, 17, in Jerusalem allegedly shut off cameras, deleted videos, tore ID details off a fine and tried to block a complaint.

flash_697763.description:
The Knesset plenum approved the appointment of nine temporary deputy speakers of the 26th Knesset by a vote of 38 in favor and 15 against.

The newly appointed deputy speakers are MKs Eitan Ginzburg (Together), Michael Malkieli (Shas), Limor Sonn Har Melech (Otzma Yehudit), Oded Forer (Yisrael Beytenu), Ahmed Tibi (Joint List), Waleed Taha (Ra'am), Yair Yaya Fink (The Democrats), Yitzhak Pindrus (United Torah Judaism), and Jacob Bardugo (Likud).

flash_697762.description:
Nvidia's board of directors has unanimously accepted the resignation of former CEO Jensen Huang and has no intention of reinstating him, board chair Harvey Jones announced Tuesday night.

Speaking at the beginning of the company's earnings call, Jones confirmed that the board would not consider bringing Huang back, despite the Nvidia founder's public statement earlier in the day expressing his willingness to resume his former position.

flash_697760.description: Nvidia founder Jensen Huang says he would be willing to return as CEO following his resignation over alleged affairs, but the company's board is not considering his return.

flash_697758.description: Smotrich reacts to Matan Kahana's election: Will go down in infamy

flash_697756.description: Right-wing bloc abstains, Arab parties vote in favor: MK Matan Kahana elected Knesset Speaker

flash_697754.description: Yael, the daughter of the IDF Spokesperson, completed the officers' course at Bahad 1 and received her father's platoon commander pin, which he had worn during his own military service.

flash_697752.description: Israeli biotech company LiVA Bio has developed a sticker that helps strawberries stay fresh longer, with British trials showing a significant reduction in spoilage and food waste.

flash_697750.description: The Together party chairman makes clear to his partners that he will not give up on the "revolution of those who serve" and continues to promote a unity government, while stopping short of ruling out joining a government with Netanyahu.

flash_697748.description: In her maiden Knesset speech, Yashar MK Shira Shapiro urges lawmakers to debate respectfully without compromising their principles.

flash_697746.description: Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar condemns Britain's latest sanctions as a "hostile act," vows to protect Israeli companies and strengthen Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria.

flash_697744.description: Byline Times spent six months investigating who among those calling out antisemitism reposts whom. I spent six minutes applying the same method to Byline. Opinion.

flash_697742.description: Two strangers to the Jewish community who helped save victims of the Bondi Beach massacre found love in the aftermath. Now, a Sydney rabbi has offered to officiate at their wedding.

flash_697740.description: President Herzog and Iranian Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi call for an end to the Iranian regime and express hope for future peace and friendship between Israel and Iran.

flash_697738.description: A Tel Aviv resident and kollel student was arrested at Ben Gurion Airport as he left the terminal after seeing his family off for a flight.

flash_697736.description: CNN reported that the US National Security Agency's classified communications network went down. The scope and cause of the outage are under investigation.

flash_697734.description: A new poll puts President Trump's approval rating at just 32 percent. Only 31 percent expressed support for the war against Iran. The Senate Democratic leader is also seeing a sharp drop in support.

flash_697786.description: He denounces the prime minister while refusing to acknowledge that Israel is a free society. Opinion.

flash_697785.description: France's Mizrachi president Yitzhak Bar Sheshet describes growing fears in the Jewish community to Arutz Sheva, warning, 'Jews are very afraid of the day after the elections.'

flash_697783.description: The Israeli economy's impressive growth figures surprised many. Economist Erez Zadok says there is no reason to be shocked.

flash_697781.description: The Ohr L'Achim organization is warning of a Christian gathering planned for the Bnei Brak area that is being presented as a musical evening.

flash_697779.description:
The Portland Trail Blazers suffered a 106-105 loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves, marking their second consecutive defeat to the same opponent.

Deni Avdija did not play due to a foot injury. Portland's next game is scheduled for Thursday night in Milwaukee, and it remains unclear whether Avdija will be fit to play.

flash_697778.description: Italy's parliament approves legislation adopting the IHRA definition of antisemitism, as supporters cite rising incidents and critics warn of limits on free speech.

flash_697777.description: The American dream was never really ours. We were immigrants who went along with what is another culture's destiny. In Israel, it's different. Here we are fulfilling our own destiny. Opinion.

flash_697775.description: Raviv Drucker apologizes on air for the major discrepancies between election polls, exit polls, and the actual results, admitting that viewers had been given a misleading picture for months.

flash_697773.description: Police are searching for a man suspected of damaging a synagogue in Richmond Hill, north of Toronto, amid continued concerns over antisemitic incidents in the area.

flash_697771.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio says there is no imminent Iranian threat to Washington, criticizing intelligence leaks following reports of a possible dirty bomb plot.

flash_697769.description: Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed accuses the US of enabling genocide in Gaza, questions Israel's Jewish identity and rejects criticism over antisemitism concerns.

flash_697767.description: Iran reportedly sees Republican midterm losses as a victory and is toughening its demands in nuclear and ceasefire talks, believing Trump faces growing pressure.

flash_697765.description:
Alerts were issued in Bahrain, with residents urged to move to safe areas.

Meanwhile, authorities in Kuwait announced that they were responding to a drone attack.

flash_697761.description:
The Likud party criticized the election of new Knesset Speaker Matan Kahana, claiming that the appointment was made unilaterally with the votes of individuals the party describes as supporters of terrorism. Likud called the move "a low point in Knesset history."

"The people of Israel oppose handing over the keys to power in this country to those who disrespect the national anthem. The people of Israel yearn for unity. Today, Eisenkot, Bennett, and Liberman chose supporters of terrorism over national unity. History will remember them for it," Likud said in a statement.

flash_697759.description:
Otzma Yehudit chairman Itamar Ben Gvir criticized Matan Kahana following his election as Knesset Speaker, accusing him of securing the position with the support of individuals he described as "criminals, supporters of terrorism, and an adviser to Arafat."

"Matan Kahana, these are the people you have to thank for becoming Knesset Speaker. Disgraceful," Ben Gvir said.

flash_697850.description:
A two-year-old toddler was moderately injured after being bitten by a dog at a house on Louis Marshall Street in Tel Aviv.

The MDA team provided her with medical treatment and evacuated her to Dana Hospital.

flash_697849.description: Greek media report that Abraham Minos-Moissis, a former president of the Jewish community in Athens, was the target of the Iranian assassination plot.

flash_697847.description:
Senior leader of the Together party, Yair Lapid, addressed the coalition negotiations and clarified that he and Naftali Bennett continue to work to establish a government of change headed by Gadi Eisenkot.

He said that meetings, security updates, and conversations in the current period spark rumors and speculation, but do not divert them from the goal.

Lapid emphasized that the goal is "to establish a new, good and effective government that will know how to deal with the security, economic and political challenges that Israel faces."

flash_697846.description: It can’t be both feared in the Middle East and loved in the West. Opinion.

flash_697845.description: Leaders of the anti-Netanyahu bloc met at the Knesset to discuss political moves. They said, "We see eye to eye on the urgency of forming a national emergency government".

flash_697843.description: Senior Religious Zionist rabbis urged Rabbi Lando and Rabbi Hirsch to prevent a government including haredi and Arab parties, saying, "We ask you not to be party to this terrible crime".

flash_697841.description: Following Ahmad Tibi's reappointment as deputy Knesset speaker, Moshe Feiglin tells Arutz Sheva that Tibi used his time chairing plenary sessions to demean MKs, arguing that his past conduct should bar his return to the role.

flash_697839.description: Left-wing activists reject Jewish residents' invitation to sit down and talk during a tense confrontation near a new Jewish community in the Jericho area.

flash_697837.description: IDF's 2027 plan caps combat reservists' service at 58 days, including 42 operational days. Fewer battalions will serve in Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Judea and Samaria; regular brigades resume training. IDF warns ongoing strain will erode war readiness.

flash_697835.description: Trump's Board of Peace accuses Israel and Hamas of failing to meet ceasefire obligations, warning that stalled disarmament threatens the Gaza agreement.

flash_697832.description: Likud brought forward bills on Hamas and tefillin to embarrass the opposition, but the Eisenkot bloc left the plenum, and the bills passed a preliminary reading.

flash_697830.description: The Land makes us one nation. Even if there are disagreements, in the end, we are one nation.

flash_697828.description: Why did the Torah mention Yaakov's departure? Why didn't it just say where he wa headedl

flash_697826.description: Itzik Bonzel, father of fallen soldier Amit Bonzel, is demanding that Matan Kahana remove his son's photo from the Knesset following the Arab parties' support for Kahana's election.

flash_697824.description: Xi Jinping personally greets Trump with a red carpet, military honors and an embrace in Shenzhen ahead of unprecedented talks with Putin.

flash_697822.description: The Jewish claim to Eretz Yisrael did not begin with modern diplomacy, nor was it granted by an international institution.

flash_697820.description: IDF Chief of Staff, CENTCOM Chief meet in Tel Aviv

flash_697889.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said it received a report that a tanker was struck by an "unidentified projectile" off the coast of Oman yesterday while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz.

According to the report, no crew members were injured. The extent of the damage to the tanker and the environmental impact of the incident are still being assessed.

flash_697888.description: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani defends his October 7 post accusing Israel of genocide, arguing that the anniversary should acknowledge the impact of the war in Gaza.

flash_697887.description: Extremist haredi protesters block MK Meir Porush's car in Jerusalem, but his driver manages to leave the scene shortly afterward.

flash_697884.description:
The US aircraft carrier "George Washington", one of three aircraft carriers operating in the Middle East, has left the region and is apparently making its way back to its home port in Japan, Bloomberg reported, citing two US sources.

The departure comes after the US aircraft carrier "Theodore Roosevelt" arrived in the Middle East on Monday.

flash_697885.description: Haredi extremists block car of a former MK on Bar Ilan Street in Jerusalem

flash_697882.description:
A 17-year-old girl was moderately injured and another person was lightly injured following a vehicle overturn in Nir Yaffe.

MDA teams provided medical treatment to the two and evacuated them to HaEmek Hospital in Afula.

flash_697881.description:
U.S. President Donald Trump expressed frustration with Vice President JD Vance after Vance blamed Republicans’ midterm election loss on the administration’s decision to strike Iran, The New York Times reported Wednesday evening.

According to the report, Trump was initially unbothered by Vance’s remarks. He later complained in private conversations that Vance had failed to publicly defend the decision to go to war with Iran and make clear that it was the right call.

Read more

flash_697879.description: A woman from central Israel has been diagnosed with rabies and is in critical condition. An epidemiological investigation raised suspicions that she contracted the disease from a stray dog found in Kfar Ruth.

flash_697877.description: The Attorney General is expected to refile the indictment against MK Tally Gotliv after the formation of the new government and the establishment of the Knesset House Committee.

flash_697875.description:
Earlier today (Wednesday), IDF and ISA personnel began a targeted operational activity to dismantle a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line that posed an immediate and direct threat to IDF troops.

Prior to the activity, a warning was issued to civilians by the Coordination and Liaison Administration, instructing them to avoid approaching the area and informing them of a road closure in the area.

flash_697873.description: Eight people were injured in a ramming incident at several locations in Kafr Qasim's industrial zone. A suspect was arrested, and investigators are examining whether he was driving under the influence of drugs.

flash_697871.description:
The Ministry of Health has reported a case of rabies in a human and has opened an epidemiological investigation. The source of exposure is suspected to be a six-month-old dog that was found on August 27 on the side of a road in Kfar Ruth, was collected from the scene and died a few days later. The ministry has begun locating and vaccinating people who may have been exposed, while the Ministry of Agriculture is simultaneously investigating contacts with other animals.

The Ministry of Health calls on anyone who suspects they have come into contact with the dog in the Kfar Ruth area and its surroundings starting August 17th to contact the health office nearest to their place of residence as soon as possible.

flash_697870.description: True love is when one values that opportunity to share one’s life with another.

flash_697869.description: Delegation representing all 50 US states visits southern Israeli city attacked by Hamas on October 7, planting trees as part of an initiative to strengthen ties between Israel and future American leaders.

flash_697867.description: Nir Zuk is expected to fund most of a $47 million capital raise for digital bank Esh, increasing his ownership stake after a planned acquisition by Isracard collapsed.

flash_697865.description: Haredi parties are demanding that the anti-Netanyahu bloc grant yeshiva students draft exemptions without sanctions, halt arrests, pardon draft evaders and provide legal commitments in advance.

flash_697863.description: The human soul may rise through prayer, contemplation, study, and the search for truth, but its achievement is incomplete if it never comes back to the world of human experience.

flash_697861.description: Sgt. Tz., a Flotilla 7 submarine course graduate, discusses underwater dangers, separation from home and Shabbat aboard a submarine. He also addresses doubts about his combat role and explains why he chose the sea over running through the hills.

flash_697913.description: A Jewish state that depends on Arabs for its survival will not be Jewish or a state for long, but there may be way out of the coalition woes. Opinion.

flash_697912.description: Tourette syndrome primarily affects children and teenagers, and no cure has yet been found. A newly developed device is succeeding in stopping involuntary movements.

flash_697910.description: Anti-Israel activists protest Yoav Gallant's appearance at a Manhattan security event, demanding his arrest over alleged war crimes in Gaza.

flash_697908.description: Meeting between Trump and Putin concludes after 40 minutes

flash_697904.description: A ladder to the heavens and a House of G-d on Earth: Yaakov discovers the wages of deception.

flash_697902.description: US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin met in Shenzhen, China, ahead of a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

flash_697901.description: Former New York Assemblyman Dov Hikind calls on Jews to boycott Mayor Zohran Mamdani's Hanukkah celebration, citing the mayor's refusal to attend the Israel Day Parade.

flash_697899.description: Heavy rain causes the roof of a Florida synagogue to collapse, leaving its sanctuary unsafe, but a rabbi manages to rescue a Torah that survived the Holocaust.

flash_697897.description: Netanyahu is reportedly urging Trump to join a new military campaign against Iran lasting up to seven days, as Washington weighs intelligence and military options.

flash_697895.description: Trump on a possible deal with Iran: We have to have a lasting deal

flash_697893.description: Trump says Iran may be pursuing biological and chemical weapons but urges Americans not to panic over reports of a possible attack on Washington.

flash_697891.description: Hundreds of Vizhnitz Hasidim visit Joseph's Tomb to pray for the recovery of their Rebbe, a senior member of Agudat Yisrael's Council of Torah Sages.

flash_697886.description: The Iranian Navy claims that three oil tankers caught fire and were disabled after striking naval mines while sailing east of the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_697983.description: A young Israeli collapsed while showering during the Annapurna trek in Nepal and died following exposure to gas. The Chabad House issued a warning to travelers in the area.

flash_697982.description: The mayor of Kfar Saba sent a relative to fetch his tefillin bag from his office. An inspection revealed watches inside, including a Rolex.

flash_697980.description: Combat engineer Osher Avraham, 19, of Rehovot, was found dead in his room at a northern base on Friday.

flash_697978.description: Kirsten Schwalbe, 112, reportedly served in leadership positions within Denmark's Nazi Party during World War II, despite previously claiming she had little interest in politics.

flash_697976.description: Acting on intelligence, Jerusalem-area Border Police stopped a suspicious car at the a-Za'ayyem crossing and found two illegal residents from Jenin hidden in its trunk. The driver, an Ashkelon resident in his 20s, was arrested along with them.

flash_697974.description: Gamal Sadat recalls his father's historic decision to make peace with Israel, the personal price he paid, and his enduring belief that courageous leaders can bring reconciliation to the Middle East.

flash_697972.description: Following repeated complaints about excessive noise from a mosque in Tel Sheva, police disconnected the loudspeakers and confiscated the amplification equipment.

flash_697970.description: The Eisenkot bloc's parties have nominated retired Supreme Court Justice Yosef Elron for state comptroller after the High Court voided the previous election and its winner, coalition nominee Michael Rabilo, withdrew his candidacy.

flash_697968.description: MK Rothman pledges a determined fight against opposition moves to repeal the judicial reform, saying the committees pursuing the repeal are part of a campaign for the next election.

flash_697966.description: A confrontation broke out between Joint List MK Hassan al-Nasasra and a police officer after the lawmaker said he saw officers beating and humiliating a handcuffed detainee by the roadside.

flash_697964.description: A 37-year-old suspect allegedly punched a Jewish man wearing a kippah after questioning him about his religion and Zionism. The suspect was already facing charges in two separate assault cases.

flash_697962.description: Archaeological excavations at the former Nazi concentration camp uncover ash, bone fragments, and the foundations of SS guard dog kennels, shedding new light on the camp's operations.

flash_697960.description: Muslim Zionist advocate Sara Zoabi criticizes Arab MKs who left the plenum during "Hatikvah". Speaking to Arutz Sheva, she explains why she proudly sings the anthem and reveals the steep personal cost of her views, even among those close to her.

flash_697958.description: Haredi factions are planning to block off the major traffic artery after a man was arrested while dropping off relatives at the airport.

flash_697957.description: A haredi deserter from Rishon Lezion was arrested at his home overnight. His detention sentence extends beyond his wedding date, scheduled for less than two weeks from now.

flash_697956.description: US, UK, France, and Germany demand Iran restore IAEA access, warning that its enriched uranium stockpile remains unverified amid nuclear concerns.
